author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: Single clk_sys reaches both bus_stage instances through the exact alias clk_buf; reset is synchronous with a set_input_delay, all inputs and outputs are contracted to clk_sys. Only INFO inventory (CDC-001, CST-001, CDC-029 declared synchronous, CST-012 Same) is expected.

author_reading.rationale: Single clock clk_sys through a buffered alias into two hierarchical stages with synchronous reset constrained by set_input_delay; no crossing and complete I/O delays.

labels.rationale: Both pipeline stages trace through the exact clk_buf alias to clk_sys. Their synchronous reset, data input, and output are timed to that clock.

Both bus_stage instances u_s0 and u_s1 are clocked by exact wire alias clk_buf = clk_sys, with synchronous reset sync_rst_n and all input/output ports completely constrained to clk_sys in intent.sdc, yielding a single-domain design with no CDC, RDC, or CST defects or obligations.
